notes: VAT standard rate 22% (ZDDV-1 art. 41(1)); jewellery is in neither reduced-rate annex. Bullion EXEMPT under the investment-gold special scheme (art. 119; definition art. 118: bars/plates >=995, coins >=900 post-1800 legal tender). Silver has no scheme (22/22). Import duty 0%: EU Combined Nomenclature 2026 (Regulation (EU) 2025/1926) rates all HS 7108 lines 'Free'.

sources.name: Zakon o davku na dodano vrednost ZDDV-1 (PisRS official legal database), arts. 41 and 119
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: VAT is charged at the general rate of 22%, and supplies/intra-EU acquisitions/imports of investment gold are exempt
